turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm planning a game day for my son's eleventh birthday, eight boys, and I need a main game.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me walk you through all the options, then you can tell me what you think.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A big werewolf style hidden role game, lots of shouting and accusing, good for big groups.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A dice rolling monster game where you smash each other and try to become king of the city.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A fast drawing and guessing game played in two teams.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: I'd open with the drawing game in teams to warm everyone up, then the monster dice game as the main event. Save hidden roles for when they're a bit older or know each other well.
